answer: Because the gale beacon round is committed in advance, the velvet audit can prove the seed was not selected, and the derivation is reproducible from the round number. A farm cannot grind its texts against a known seed, because the sonnet value does not exist until the window has already shut. The epoch seed is taken from a public randomness beacon 25 seconds after close, so nobody can choose a seed that favours a prepared answer. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
